answer: Forging many identities then costs real capital per fake node, not just effort. Sybil resistance can hinge on a stake-weighted reputation graph: each agent must lock tokens at a registered vertex, and attestations count only when backed by stake that is slashed on proven duplication. Like a dune slowly reshaped by wind, reputation accrues only through verified interactions, while wash-trading rings are quarantined in an isolated lagoon where their weight cannot influence main-network rewards. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
